packageRules.description: Kubernetes libraries are version-locked to controller-runtime — api, apimachinery, client-go and apiextensions-apiserver must move as a set, so keep them in one PR.
The go directive in go.mod is a deliberate floor, not something to chase. CI, the builder image and golangci-lint v1.59 are all pinned to the same Go line; raising it is a manual decision.
Keep the builder image on the Go line the module targets. golangci-lint v1.59 cannot parse export data from a newer Go, so a silent bump here breaks the lint job.

The Riak operand image pins per-architecture bases and full RPM URLs that were chosen by hand (some upstream aarch64 builds SIGILL on non-SVE arm64 — see CLAUDE.md). Version changes here are a curation decision, never an automatic one.
ghcr.io/marthydavid/* images are this repository's own build output. Their tags are set by the release and chart-bump process, not by dependency updates.
Group routine GitHub Actions bumps into a single PR; majors still get their own.
Build and test tooling moves together: it only affects CI and local development, never the shipped operator.
golangci-lint v2 renamed the configuration format, so a major bump needs .golangci.yml migrated by hand in the same PR. Keep it isolated and labelled.
